verses.text: Since Christ suffered in his body, arm yourselves with the same attitude. Whoever suffers in the body is done with sin,
so they don’t spend the rest of their earthly life chasing human desires, but live for God’s will.
You’ve already spent enough time doing what the nations choose to do: living wildly, chasing desires, getting drunk, partying, drinking hard, and worshiping idols.
They’re surprised you don’t plunge into the same flood of reckless living, and they insult you.
But they’ll have to answer to the one ready to judge the living and the dead.
That’s why the good news was preached even to those who are now dead, so that though they were judged in the body as people are, they could live in the spirit as God does.
The end of all things is near. So be clearheaded and self-controlled so you can pray.
Above all, keep loving one another deeply, because love covers many sins.
Each of you should use whatever gift you’ve received to serve others, as faithful stewards of God’s varied grace.

If anyone speaks, let it be as someone speaking God’s words. If anyone serves, let it be with the strength God provides, so that God may be praised in everything through Jesus Christ. Glory and power belong to him forever and ever. Amen.
Dear friends, don’t be surprised by the fiery trial happening among you to test you, as if something strange were happening.
Instead, rejoice that you share in Christ’s sufferings, so you can be overjoyed when his glory is revealed.
If you’re insulted because of Christ’s name, you’re blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
None of you should suffer as a murderer, thief, criminal, or meddler.
But if you suffer as a Christian, don’t be ashamed. Praise God that you bear that name.
For the time has come for judgment to begin with God’s household. If it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who don’t obey God’s good news?
“If it’s hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
So those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust themselves to their faithful Creator and keep doing good.
